record.original_question: Let f be a Hecke-Maass cusp form of level 1 with spectral parameter t_f. Prove the Weyl-strength subconvex estimate L(1/2 + it, f) <<_epsilon ((1 + |t_f - t|)(1 + |t_f + t|))^(1/6 + epsilon) uniformly, including the conductor-dropping regimes where t_f - t or t_f + t is small relative to max{t_f, |t|}.

evidence.quote: Let f be a Hecke–Maass cusp form of level 1. Prove the Weyl-strength subconvex bound L(1/2 + it, f ) <<_epsilon ((1 + |tf − t|)(1 + |tf + t|))^(1/6+epsilon). This is known ... away from the conductor-dropping regimes ... Michel-Venkatesh prove a subconvex bound in the conductor-dropping regime, but the exponent is not explicit.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f$ be a Hecke–Maass cusp form for the full modular group $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ (level $1$), normalized so that its Laplace eigenvalue is $\tfrac{1}{4}+t_f^2$ for some real spectral parameter $t_f>0$. Let $L(s,f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\lambda_f(n)n^{-s}$ denote its standard $L$-function (with $\lambda_f(n)$ the Hecke eigenvalues), analytically continued to $s\in\mathbb{C}$.

Prove that for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a constant $C_\varepsilon>0$ such that
$$\bigl|L\!\left(\tfrac{1}{2}+it,\,f\right)\bigr|\;\le\;C_\varepsilon\,\bigl((1+|t_f-t|)(1+|t_f+t|)\bigr)^{\frac{1}{6}+\varepsilon}$$
holds uniformly for all real $t$ and all such forms $f$. The bound is required to hold in full uniformity, including the so-called conductor-dropping regimes where $\min(|t_f-t|,|t_f+t|)$ is small compared to $\max(t_f,|t|)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Weyl-strength subconvex bounds in the t-aspect for GL(2) L-functions are known away from the conductor-dropping regime, and Michel–Venkatesh established a (non-explicit) subconvex bound in the conductor-dropping regime. A fully uniform Weyl exponent 1/6 covering all regimes does not appear to have been established; recent work (e.g., on sub-Weyl bounds for GL(2)) is still in progress, suggesting the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Sub-Weyl bound for GL(2) via trivial delta
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on Weyl-strength and sub-Weyl bounds for GL(2) L-functions in the t-aspect, indicating subconvexity exponents in this regime are still being refined.
status_evidence.claim: Weyl-strength bounds for GL(2) L-functions remain an active research area, with uniform results across all regimes not yet established.

status_evidence.title: Weyl-type hybrid subconvexity bounds for twisted L-functions
status_evidence.snippet: Weyl-type hybrid subconvexity bounds proved in certain ranges; conductor-dropping regimes are technically delicate.
status_evidence.claim: Hybrid Weyl bounds are known in many ranges but uniform treatment of the conductor-dropping regime with explicit Weyl exponent is not standard.
